title: Union Army cipher telegram books 1864-1868 (NARA RG 107 628803, RG 108 604437, RG 393 4486363/5081118/5131597)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 107, Telegrams in Cipher (naId 628803), item 3854723: Butler to Biggs, 24 July 1864
documents.route: Maj. Gen. B. F. Butler (Army of the James HQ) -> Lt. Col. Biggs

plaintext.source: Central Telegraph Office route worksheet filed with the telegram; stamped 'Printed in War Records' (OR vol 40 pt 3 p 432, not checked).

transcription.notes: 59 words counted on the form (matches the operator's count 59). Words, not letters: unit 'code groups' stands for cipher words.

documents.route: War Department, Grant, Halleck, department commands <-> field commands

plaintext.source: RG 107: deciphering worksheets per catalogue scope note; RG 108: fair copies; RG 393 unknown.

system.summary: Union Army route cipher: plain words written into a 7-column grid, read off by a column route with blind words, code words for names, times and dates.
system.notes: Route for item A: up 1, down 6, up 4, down 2, up 3, down 5, up 7; blind word after each column. The route book in use is not identified.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary worksheet filed with item A; printed in OR Ser. I vol. 40 pt. 3 p. 432 (checked); RG 108 fair copies

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input.

solution.what: NARA proxy API on the five naIds: only item 3854723 (RG 107) is online; RG 108 and RG 393 not digitised. RG 393 naIds duplicate catalogue 680 (army1865).
Transcribed Butler-Biggs 24 July 1864 telegram (59 words) and its 7-column route worksheet.
Reconstructed the route from the worksheet (up 1, down 6, up 4, down 2, up 3, down 5, up 7, blind word after each column); reproduces the grid except one cell.
Web search for the OR text and for RG 108 in print; Huntington Eckert papers identified as route-book source. OR vol 40 pt 3 p 432 not opened.

Opened OR Ser. I vol. 40 pt. 3 p. 432 (archive.org djvu text): Butler to Biggs printed, matches the worksheet word for word; last grid row read as 'This is to be confidential'. Four end-row words, 'unity i' and the opening 'Forward gam gobble' still unread.

gaps.item: item A: 'dont shall walrus knox', 'unity i' and opening 'Forward gam gobble' (code/blind/indicator words)

outcome.notes: Only one item online; it was deciphered at the time and printed. Rest blocked on access; RG 393 overlaps catalogue 680.
